name: Sikafloor®-33 PurCem®
tagline: UV stable polyurethane pigmented finish coat for PurCem HB-22 system
summary: Sikafloor Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® is a Polyutethane/Cement coating that provides a UV colour stable option for the Sikafloor PurCem HB-22 textured heavy duty system.
metaDescription: Sikafloor Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® is a Polyutethane/Cement coating that provides a UV colour stable option for the Sikafloor PurCem HB-22 textured heavy duty system.
attributes: HACCP - Food grade approved as part of the PurCem HB-22 System.
Integrated with Sikafloor 31 PurCem coating componants - part B substitution only required.
usage: Food and Beverage production and Processing facilities.
In Commercial Food premises where UV stability for optimum appearance is important.
advantages: HACCP - Food grade approved as part of the PurCem HB-22 System.
Integrated with Sikafloor 31 PurCem coating componants - part B substitution only required.
packaging: 5.2kg kit: A+B+C+Pigment Part A 1.3kg Part B 1.9kg Part C 1.6 kg Pigment 0.4kg PurCem Accelerator: Required for installation temperature below 20 degrees C to achieve similar curing to Sikafloor 31PurCem- please refer to the below Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator Addition Guide: Temp 15 Degrees C - 200mls/5.2kg kit Temp 10 Degrees C - 250mls/5.2kg kit

items.label: Shelf life
items.text:
Part A 9 months
Part B 6 months
Part C 6 months
Pigment 9 months

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store between +5 and +30 degrees

items.label: Abrasion resistance
items.text: 1.57 g - ASTM D 4060

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text: 1.75 Mpa - ASTM D 3441

items.label: Skid / slip resistance
items.text:
Sikafloor PurCem systems cater for and conform to a range of textures as per P rating AS 4585-2013
These ratings depend on the requirement of a given facility and are generally P4- P5 for wet areas
Refer to Sika Techncial Dept for further information and documentation

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text:
Excellent resistance to a wide range of chemicals.
Refer to PurCem Chemical resistance document.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text:
Only mix full kits of Sikafloor 33 PurCem and ensure the correct amount of PurCem accelerator is added as per the below guide.
5.2kg kit: A+B+C+Pigment
Part A 1.3kg Part B 1.9kg Part C 1.6 kg Pigment 0.4kg
PurCem Accelerator: Required for installation temperature below 20 degrees C to achieve similar curing to Sikafloor 31PurCem- please refer to the below Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator Addition Guide:
Temp 15 Degrees C - 200mls/5.2kg kit Temp 10 Degrees C - 250mls/5.2kg kit

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: Do not apply below 10 degrees C or above 30 degrees C

items.label: Relative air humidity
items.text: Maximum RH - 85%

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Apply on substrates below 10% surface moisture ( See Sikafloor HB-22 PurCem TDS )

items.label: Pot Life
items.text: 15-20 minutes at 20 degrees C

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Foot traffic - 24hrs ( at 20 degrees C)
Vehicular traffic 36 h ( at 20degrees C)
Full chemical cure 5 days (at 20 degrees C)

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text: 16h min / 48 h max (at 20 degrees C)

items.label: Consumption
items.text: As a coating for Sikafloor HB-22 Textured system - approx 1.8 - 2.2 M2 per litre per coat (6.5 - 8.0 m2 per 3.71L kit )

items.label: EQUIPMENT
MIXING
items.text:
Mixing will be affected by temperature; condition materials for use to 18 - 15 Degrees C.
1. Add pigment to part A, stir for for approximately 15 seconds.
2. Add component B, mix for approx 30 seconds.
3. While mixing, add component C within 15 seconds.
4. Further mix for 2 minutes until the mixture is homogeneous and the pigment is uniformly dispersed.
5. If required add the required amount of Sikafloor PurCem accelerator and mix for a further 30 seconds.
Use material immediately
Note: Failure to follow the above may result in uneven gloss and or colour in the finished product

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Apply evenly with correct roller and roller sleeves as decribed in Equipment section.
For best results on textured HB-22 systems, pour the product onto the surface in lines and apply out with a rubber tipped squeegee.
"Lay off" the excess with the rollers to create and even distribution in the texture.
Performing this then at a right angle will futher even out the product distribution .
Note:
Mixing buckets should be discarded for new ones approx every 3-4 mixes at 20 degrees C.
Roller sleeves should be dicarded for new ones approx every 30 minutes at 20 degrees C.
Failure to do this will likely result in uneven texture and sheen in the finished product.
For lighter colours and or being applied on Broadcast B1 texture, consideration should be given to a second coat to ensure full colour distrbution.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean equipment with Sika Colma Cleaner

rel.t: High strength, water-based polyurethane hybrid coving and detailing mortar
rel.s: Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® is a multi-component, polyurethane hybrid mortar. It has high impact and mechanical resistance, good resistance against chemicals and wear.

rel.t: Water based polyurethane cementitious hybrid coating
rel.s: Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® is a multi-component, water-based coloured polyurethane hybrid flooring coating. It has a matt, impervious, chemical resistant, hard wearing surface.
